page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: manuscript-like "Nro. III." above the title (printed numeral). Title block centred in large capitals and roman type; a printed ornament below; a text block of motto and verse; date at foot. Stamps, shelf marks and handwriting are not transcribed. Faint show-through text in the right margin is not transcribed.

l.i: Prophetæ duo aut tres loquantur, & alij diiudicent:
Quod si quid alij patefactum fuerit assidenti, prior

page.notes: Printed ornament between the motto block and the Corinthians citation; stamp "8° 11235" and "Coll. ..." manuscript at top right, "Su 183" stamp and manuscript shelf marks at the foot, and a pencil "M 29.971" at right are not transcribed. The ornament is not text. The "1." before CORINTH is read as the printed numeral 1 with superscript-style spacing. Show-through text from the reverse is not transcribed.
